answer: Each account must register with a bonded deposit and a one-time proof of personhood, so a single human yields exactly one vote weight. The registry caps weight per verified resource, the way an island charter grants one seat per household instead of per forged name. So a fresh lotus badge or a cloned walnut wallet still burns its own non-transferable bond, and since bonds are slashed on collusion, every extra identity carries independent capital at risk that the network can seize.
